context.title: Can't settle even when you're tired?
context.caption: Can't settle even when you're tired? The sky is calm today, a small breather with room to recoup, and your body may need a little time to catch up. Keep lights warm and dim after sunset and ease off caffeine earlier, and take it slow this evening.
context.affects: Sleep may come a bit easier for some, especially if nights have felt jumpy lately. The steadier backdrop can help the body’s wind-down signals line up. If rest is still patchy, that can be lag from recent days or from local factors like heat, pressure swings, or allergens.
context.voiceover: Can't settle even when you're tired? Even with a calmer backdrop today, some people may still feel that thin, papery restlessness at the edges. Space weather is quiet—no disruptive solar bursts pointing our way—so the body’s wind‑down cues have a cleaner lane to line up. If you’re still tossing, that can be leftover momentum from recent days or from local stuff like heat, pressure swings, or allergens.
